name: 100% Completion
summary: 100% game completion is a checklist: 69 story missions, 20 Strangers and Freaks missions, 42 hobbies and pastimes, 14 random events and 16 miscellaneous activities (several sources agree on these counts). It is separate from achievements/trophies and from the Social Club.

sections.title: Required counts
sections.text: Several sources agree that 100% needs 69 story missions, 20 Strangers and Freaks missions, 42 hobbies and pastimes, 14 random events and 16 miscellaneous activities (GamePressure's appendix and GTABase both give these numbers).

sections.title: Category weights
sections.text: GTABase gives the percentage weights as: story missions 55%, Strangers and Freaks 10%, hobbies and pastimes 10%, random events 5%, miscellaneous activities 20% (total 100%). Another guide quoted different weights, so treat the exact split as single-source.

sections.title: Story missions
sections.text: All 69 missions from the Prologue through one of the three endings; any heist approach or path is fine (GTABase).

sections.title: Strangers and Freaks
sections.text: GTABase says only Franklin's Strangers and Freaks count: Barry's Grass Roots (4), Beverly Felton's Paparazzo (6), Dom Beasley's Risk Assessment (4), Hao's Shift Work (1), Mary-Ann Quinn's Exercising Demons (1), Omega's Far Out and The Final Frontier (2), Peter Dreyfuss' A Starlet in Vinewood (1) and Tonya Wiggins' Pulling Favors (5) — which adds up to 24, while the headline requirement in several guides is 20. The sources do not reconcile this, so confirm in-game before relying on it.

sections.title: Hobbies and pastimes (42)
sections.text: GTABase counts: Flight School 12, Shooting Range 6, Hao street races 5, off-road races 6, sea races 4, triathlons 3, tennis 1, darts 1, golf 1, parachuting (all base/heli jumps) and one strip-club private dance — 42 required out of about 61 available.

sections.title: Random events (14)
sections.text: Any 14 random events count; you choose which. There are about 60 in total (GTABase).

sections.title: Miscellaneous activities (16 of 30)
sections.text: Required: buy 5 properties; buy a vehicle from a website; walk or play fetch with Chop; complete Booty Call; receive a prostitute's service; hold up a store; visit the cinema; four friend activities (cinema, bar, strip club, darts); collect 50 spaceship parts; collect 50 letter scraps; complete 25 of 50 stunt jumps; 25 of 50 under-the-bridge flights; and 8 of 15 knife flights.

sections.title: What does NOT count
sections.text: Per GTABase: Michael's and Trevor's Strangers and Freaks, the remaining hobbies, the other random events, properties beyond five, weapons and vehicles, tattoos, haircuts and enhanced-edition exclusives (such as Peyote Plants and Monkey Mosaics) are not required.

sections.title: 100% is not achievements
sections.text: The in-game completion percentage (Pause menu → Stats) is not the same as the achievements/trophies list; 100% completion has its own achievement/trophy, Career Criminal. The Social Club checklist and statistics from other versions are separate.

name: 100%: story missions
summary: For 100% you need 69 story missions, from the Prologue through one of the three endings; every heist approach is acceptable. (This is the required number, not the number of mission entries in this knowledge base: see the counting methodology.)

sections.title: What counts
sections.text: 69 story missions through one of the three endings; any heist approach or path is fine (GTABase). One guide adds that the five Lester assassination contracts are included in the 69; the others do not say, so treat that as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Who plays them
sections.text: Story missions are played by whichever protagonist the mission belongs to; there is nothing to choose except the heist approaches and the ending.

name: How missions are counted (79 vs 69 vs 68 vs 86)
summary: This knowledge base lists 79 story mission entries (the ordered list on Grand Theft Wiki: Prologue, main missions, heist setups, heists, 5 Lester contracts and 3 endings). Other sites give other numbers because they count differently: 100% needs 69; GTA5Wiki's story page shows 68; GamePressure advertises 86. The differences are scope, not errors.

sections.title: Why the numbers differ
sections.text: Our 79 = the Grand Theft Wiki ordered mission list, counting every setup mission (including three 'Getaway Vehicle' setups), every heist, the five Lester assassination contracts and all three ending missions (only one ending is needed). The 100% requirement (69) is a completion rule, not a total. GTA5Wiki (68) and GamePressure (86) group or split missions differently. No source is assumed wrong; the entries here follow one ordered list so every entry has a stable position.

name: 100%: Strangers and Freaks
summary: The headline requirement is 20 Strangers and Freaks missions. GTABase says only Franklin's chains count: Grass Roots (4), Paparazzo (6), Risk Assessment (4), Shift Work (1), Exercising Demons (1), Omega (2), A Starlet in Vinewood (1) and Pulling Favors (5). The listed chains sum to 24, so the sources do not fully reconcile.

sections.title: Which chains
sections.text: Required (Franklin): Barry's Grass Roots, Beverly Felton's Paparazzo, Dom Beasley's Risk Assessment, Hao, Mary-Ann Quinn's Exercising Demons, Omega, Peter Dreyfuss and Tonya Wiggins. Michael's and Trevor's chains (Epsilon Program, Maude, Civil Border Patrol, Vinewood Souvenirs…) are not required. 20 versus 24 is an open conflict.

name: 100%: hobbies and pastimes
summary: 42 of about 61 hobbies and pastimes count: Flight School 12, Shooting Range 6, Hao street races 5, off-road races 6, sea races 4, triathlons 3, tennis 1, darts 1, golf 1, parachuting and 1 strip-club dance.

sections.title: Counts
sections.text: Flight School 12; Shooting Range 6; Hao street races 5; off-road races 6; sea races 4; triathlons 3; tennis 1; darts 1; golf 1; all parachute jumps; 1 strip-club private dance (GTABase). Which protagonist can do each is not documented.

name: 100%: random events
summary: Any 14 random events count (there are about 60); you choose which ones.

sections.title: Counts
sections.text: Any 14 random events; the rest can be ignored. The Altruist cult shootout is Trevor-specific, so avoid relying on it as Michael or Franklin.

name: 100%: miscellaneous activities (16)
summary: 16 of 30 miscellaneous activities are required: 5 properties, a website vehicle purchase, time with Chop, a few leisure and friend activities, 50 spaceship parts, 50 letter scraps, 25 stunt jumps, 25 under-the-bridge flights and 8 knife flights.

sections.title: Required list
sections.text: Buy 5 properties; buy a vehicle from a website; walk or play fetch with Chop; complete Booty Call; receive a prostitute's service; hold up a store; visit the cinema; friend activities (cinema, bar, strip club, darts); collect 50 spaceship parts; collect 50 letter scraps; 25 of 50 stunt jumps; 25 of 50 under-the-bridge flights; 8 of 15 knife flights.

name: 100%: what you can ignore
summary: You can ignore Michael's and Trevor's Strangers and Freaks, hobbies beyond 42, all but 14 random events, properties beyond five, weapons, vehicles, tattoos, haircuts and enhanced-edition exclusives such as Peyote Plants and Monkey Mosaics.

sections.title: Not required
sections.text: Per GTABase: Michael/Trevor Strangers and Freaks, remaining hobbies, other random events, properties beyond five, all weapons and vehicles, tattoos, haircuts, and enhanced-edition exclusives. Nuclear waste, submarine pieces, hidden packages, epsilon tracts and rampages are not on the required miscellaneous list either.

name: 100%: who has to do what
aliases: qual personagem faz o quê no 100%
summary: Story missions are played by their own protagonist. For Strangers and Freaks only Franklin's chains count. Hobbies and miscellaneous items are not documented per protagonist except where noted (Hao's races are Franklin's).

sections.title: Who
sections.text: Franklin: the required Strangers and Freaks and Hao's street races. Michael: his story missions and yoga (not confirmed for 100%). Trevor: his story missions; his Rampages are not on the required list. Collectibles on the list (spaceship parts, letter scraps, jumps and flights) can be collected by any protagonist, except that the Omega mission that starts the parts is Franklin's.

name: 100%: a practical order (derived plan)
summary: A derived order for 100%: finish the story (one ending), then Franklin's required strangers, the 16 miscellaneous activities, 42 hobbies and any 14 random events. This plan is derived from the checklists and is not an official guide.

sections.title: Plan
sections.text: Step 1: play the 69 required story missions through one ending (keep Lester's contracts for after the story if you want the stock-market money). Step 2: Franklin's required strangers (24 listed; 20 headline). Step 3: miscellaneous activities (5 properties after Nervous Ron, Chop, cinema, friend activities, 50 spaceship parts after Omega, 50 letter scraps, 25 stunt jumps, 25 under-the-bridge flights, 8 knife flights). Step 4: 42 hobbies (flight school and the races take the most). Step 5: any 14 random events. Check the in-game completion percentage (Pause menu, Stats) to see what is left.
